name: badge system
description: Earn collectible badges for your Geometry Dash milestones.

show-toast.name: Show Unlock Popups
show-toast.description: Slide a popup in from the top of the screen whenever you unlock a badge.

play-sound.name: Play Unlock Sound
play-sound.description: Play the achievement sound when a badge is unlocked.

menu-button.name: Show Menu Button
menu-button.description: Add a Badges button to the main menu. Takes effect the next time the main menu loads.
